verdict.rationale: Asana's docs show its own planning objects for tracking initiatives: projects, portfolios, goals, status updates, teams and custom fields. Portfolios can be checked and status updates read. However, no evidence shows an initiative carrying a priority field or being assigned to an owning team; this is only implied by the general existence of teams and custom fields. missing for 10: explicit priority attribute on initiatives, documented team ownership of projects/portfolios/goals, first-party product docs describing initiative tracking (the evidence is mostly API/MCP references), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Learn to read status updates from Asana and share them in another tool.
Searches tasks, projects, project templates, portfolios, goals, teams, users, tags, custom fields, and AI Teammates by name.
From a single ChatGPT conversation, you can check on portfolios, create and assign tasks, kick off new projects, and review work
